text: Handling deadlines well requires good time management and clear priorities. First, plan your tasks and decide which ones are most important. This helps you focus on urgent work instead of wasting time. Next, use scope management: if a project is too big, agree with your team on what can realistically be finished on time. Good communication is also essential. Tell colleagues early if you have a problem, so they can help or adjust the plan. Finally, avoid waiting until the last minute. Start early, check your progress regularly, and stay calm. With these simple habits, you can meet deadlines more easily and reduce stress.
